skills.name: Persian Conversational
skills.summary: Write natural colloquial Persian for chats, social captions, onboarding, notifications, and friendly support—not formal or legal copy.
skills.description: Write natural colloquial Persian (محاوره‌نویسی) as Persian speakers actually write in chats, social media, consumer products, onboarding, notifications, and friendly support. Use when the user asks for فارسی محاوره‌ای، خودمونی، عامیانه، لحن دوستانه، کپشن، استوری، پیام چت, or casual Persian product copy. Do not use for legal, academic, administrative, contractual, or explicitly formal writing; use persian-formal or persian-writing when appropriate.

پیام خوش‌آمد وقتی کسی اپ را باز می‌کند
جواب پشتیبانی و چت با کاربر

skills.name: Persian Formal
skills.summary: Write formal Persian that still sounds human: proposals, contracts, invoices, official letters, email, and policy pages.
skills.description: Write formal Persian that still sounds human: proposals, contracts, invoices, official letters (نامه اداری), formal email, company website copy, terms and policies. Use whenever the user asks for فارسی رسمی، اداری، نامه، پروپوزال، قرارداد، فاکتور، متن حقوقی, or when the text goes to a client, organization, university or government office. ایمیل رسمی به مشتری یا همکار
پروپوزال و قرارداد

skills.name: Jalali Calendar
skills.summary: Handle Jalali (Solar Hijri) dates and Tehran time for Iranian products: formatting, storage, ranges, and holidays.
skills.description: Handle dates and times for Iranian users: the Jalali / Solar Hijri calendar (تقویم شمسی، هجری خورشیدی), Saturday-first weeks, Tehran time (Asia/Tehran, UTC+03:30, no DST), Persian month and weekday names, formatting, storage, conversion, date ranges, reports, age calculations and holidays. skills.name: Iran Validation
skills.summary: Validate and format Iranian IDs, mobile/landline numbers, Sheba, cards, postal codes, and plates.
